business_summary: DLE Inc. engages in the entertainment business in Japan. It engages in the animation, live action, music, mobile app and game development, event planning and management, and voice recording activities; and production management, concept designing, and other activities, as well as offers marketing solutions. The company is also involved in the movies and television businesses; and operation of in-house studios. The company was formerly known as Pasania, Ltd. and changed its name to DLE Inc. in October 2003. DLE Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.
